( 1 ) For PA-11 pipe produced after January 23, 2009, but before January 22, 2019, a DF of 0.40 may be used in the design formula, provided: ( i ) The design pressure does not exceed 200 psig; ( ii ) The material designation code is PA32312 or PA32316; ( iii ) The pipe has a nominal size (IPS or CTS) of 4 inches or less; and ( iv ) The pipe has a standard dimension ratio of SDR-11 or less ( i.e., thicker wall pipe). ( 2 ) For PA-11 pipe produced on or after January 22, 2019, a DF of 0.40 may be used in the design formula, provided: ( i ) The design pressure does not exceed 250 psig; ( ii ) The material designation code is PA32316; ( iii ) The pipe has a nominal size (IPS or CTS) of 6 inches or less; and ( iv ) The minimum wall thickness for a given outside diameter is not less than that listed in table 2 to this paragraph (d)(2)(iv) : Table 2 to Paragraph ( d )(2)(iv) PA-11 pipe: minimum wall thickness and SDR values Pipe size (inches) Minimum wall thickness (inches) Corresponding dimension ratio (values) 1 ⁄ 2 ″ CTS 0.090 7.0 1 ⁄ 2 ″ IPS 0.090 9.3 3 ⁄ 4 ″ CTS 0.090 9.7 3 ⁄ 4 ″ IPS 0.095 11 1″ CTS 0.099 11 1″ IPS 0.119 11 1 1 ⁄ 4 ″ CTS 0.121 11 1 1 ⁄ 4 ″ IPS 0.151 11 1 1 ⁄ 2 ″ IPS 0.173 11 2″ IPS 0.216 11 3″ IPS 0.259 13.5 4″ IPS 0.333 13.5 6″ IPS 0.491 13.5 ( e ) Polyamide (PA-12) pipe requirements.
